# Equipment and Weapon Permits Guide
The approval of permits is a privilege, not a right, and no head of a department is obligated to approve any permit. \nPermits are invalid if not kept on their owner's person.
For the ease of your time and the time of others, please seek required permit approval in the following order; \nItem Orgin, [color=#fcdf03]Relevant Leader[/color], [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color], [color=#86d420]Central Command[/color].
A [bold][color=#fcdf03]Relevant Leader[/color][/bold] is the highest-ranking person of a department or corporation on station for a given approved group. \nWhen seeking a permit for contraband, you must always seek approval from the [color=#fcdf03]Relevant Leader[/color] where the item originated; otherwise, you may seek out any [color=#fcdf03]Relevant Leader[/color].
[bolditalic]E.G.[/bolditalic] [italic]You get insulated gloves from engineering, you'd need the [color=#ff733c]Chief Engineer[/color]'s stamp, but if you found an abandoned pair in maintenance you could seek a stamp from any of the following: [color=#ff733c]Chief Engineer[/color], [color=#ff4242]Head of Security[/color], [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color], or [color=#b48b57]Quartermaster[/color], because this item is permitted for [color=#ff733c]Engineering[/color], [color=#ff4242]Security[/color], [color=#fcdf03]Command[/color], and [color=#b48b57]Mining[/color] respectively.[/italic]
When choosing between NT-CC Consortium, Affiliated Corporations, or Rival Corporation, use the following guide.
Any item that has at least one NT-CC Consortium Corporation or Department on it, you must seek at least one approval from them, and must seek approval from the item's origin if it has one.
[bolditalic]E.G.[/bolditalic] [italic]You bought a pair of insulated gloves from salvage, you must get the [color=#963dca]Salvage Lead[/color]'s stamp alongside a stamp from a NT-CC Consortium [color=#fcdf03]Relevant Leader[/color] see above example.[/italic]
For items without at least one NT-CC Consortium Corporation or Department on it, you only need seek out approval from the [color=#fcdf03]Relevant Leader[/color].
[bolditalic]E.G.[/bolditalic] [italic]If you wanted a brown scavenger beret, you need only the [color=#963dca]Salvage Lead[/color]'s approval.[/italic]
## NT-CC Consortium
- [bold]Tier One:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#fcdf03]Relevant Leader[/color]. - [bold]Tier Two:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#fcdf03]Relevant Leader[/color]. - [bold]Tier Three:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#fcdf03]Relevant Leader[/color]. - [bold]Tier Four:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#fcdf03]Relevant Leader[/color] and [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color]. - [bold]Tier Five:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#fcdf03]Relevant Leader[/color] and [color=#86d420]Central Command[/color].
## Affiliated Corporations
- [bold]Tier One:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#fcdf03]Relevant Leader[/color]. - [bold]Tier Two:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#fcdf03]Relevant Leader[/color]. - [bold]Tier Three:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#fcdf03]Relevant Leader[/color]. - [bold]Tier Four:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#fcdf03]Relevant Leader[/color] and [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color]. - [bold]Tier Five:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#fcdf03]Relevant Leader[/color] and [color=#86d420]Central Command[/color].
## Rival Corporations
- [bold]Tier One:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#ff4242]Warden[/color], or the below. - [bold]Tier Two:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#ff4242]Warden[/color], or the below. - [bold]Tier Three:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#ff4242]Head of Security[/color], or the below. - [bold]Tier Four:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color], or the below. - [bold]Tier Five:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color] and [color=#86d420]Central Command[/color].
## Weapon Permits
Weapon Permits follow Equipment Permits but need the following additional approvals.
- [bold]Tier One:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#ff4242]Warden[/color], or the below. - [bold]Tier Two:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#ff4242]Warden[/color], or the below. - [bold]Tier Three:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#ff4242]Head of Security[/color], or the below. - [bold]Tier Four:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#ff4242]Head of Security[/color], or the below. - [bold]Tier Five:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color] and [color=#ff4242]Head of Security[/color].
